cohort_shortfall: Only 16 cases met the inclusion rule without downloading a new corpus: each preserves a public/local locator and either a source-native money metric or a directly relevant negative/coverage case. Regulator guidance is included as evidence about available grain, not as a charity amount.

cases.source: NSW Fair Trading annual-return form CA3
cases.subject: authority holder; no named charity
cases.metric: gross fundraising appeals; aggregate gross income and direct expenditure with traders
cases.attribution_evidence: the form requires an income statement summarising each appeal and, above the threshold, aggregate income/expenditure for jointly conducted appeals
cases.incompatibilities: a template proves permissible reporting grain, not a charity's amount, method, trader, or campaign allocation
cases.missingness: no submitted return in retained cohort

cases.source: NSW Government, Reporting requirements for charitable fundraising
cases.subject: authority holder; no named charity
cases.attribution_evidence: guidance says financial statements summarise income and expenditure of each fundraising appeal
cases.incompatibilities: does not establish public accessibility or that organisation-wide financial-statement totals can be assigned to appeals

cases.subject: authority holder; no named charity
cases.attribution_evidence: records and account transactions are required per fundraising appeal
cases.incompatibilities: private record-keeping duty is not evidence of a publicly publishable amount

cases.source: NSW Government, Appeals conducted jointly with traders
cases.subject: authority holder and trader; no named pair
cases.metric: gross income and expenses of donation-only appeal
cases.attribution_evidence: guidance requires trader reporting and written agreement where an appeal is jointly conducted
cases.incompatibilities: a rule about traders does not identify an actual charity-provider relationship or permit splitting an aggregate portfolio total

cases.source: NSW Government, Managing money and proceeds of an appeal
cases.subject: authority holder; no named charity
cases.metric: money received and lawful/proper appeal expenses
cases.attribution_evidence: bank deposits and withdrawals must be identifiable and related to each appeal
cases.incompatibilities: the 50% donation-only rule is a conduct threshold, not a measured cost-to-raise-dollar or ROI

cases.subject: PFRA charity member; member identity not frozen in this study
cases.amount_status: fee/levy not an attributed charity fundraising amount
cases.attribution_evidence: membership semantics support face-to-face domain participation only when a named member is bound
cases.incompatibilities: no street/door/private-site setting, agency, regular giving, current duration, revenue, or expense may be inferred
cases.missingness: named member and dated archived roster not retained

cases.subject: agency members; no charity relationship asserted
cases.attribution_evidence: directory can identify a provider candidate, not a client relationship
cases.incompatibilities: provider roster cannot attribute any charity income/expenditure to that provider
cases.missingness: no charity-provider contract or campaign report retained

cases.subject: named charity/agency only if explicit in bulletin
cases.subject_binding: requires exact bulletin locator and identity resolution
cases.attribution_evidence: a dated explicit representative-to-charity-through-agency statement can support relationship observation
cases.incompatibilities: does not establish portfolio total, campaign total, compensation, or causal money attribution

cases.subject: award-listed charity/campaign; no row frozen
cases.attribution_evidence: a named campaign and year may be directly observed
cases.incompatibilities: award recognition is not campaign quality, return, income, expenditure, or causal effectiveness

cases.subject: benchmark-listed campaign/beneficiary; no row frozen
cases.subject_binding: benchmark row plus charity identity resolution required
cases.amount_status: not transcribed without retained row/source hash
cases.attribution_evidence: benchmark is capable of explicitly pairing named campaign and reported amount
cases.incompatibilities: reported platform/benchmark amount is not audited organisation revenue and cannot be netted against organisation expenditure
cases.missingness: specific row and metric definition not retained

cases.subject: platform campaign/client if explicitly named
cases.metric: platform-defined peer-to-peer trend or campaign amount
cases.attribution_evidence: platform may directly observe amount processed for a named campaign
cases.incompatibilities: platform coverage is not total organisation fundraising; no channel split or ROI may be calculated

cases.source: Environmental Justice Australia 2024-25 financial report retained evidence
cases.subject: Environmental Justice Australia
cases.subject_binding: exact legal/entity binding retained in Phase 5 C4 evidence review
cases.incompatibilities: total income cannot be split among practices, campaigns, appeals, or providers

cases.source: Environmental Justice Australia 2024-25 financial report retained evidence
cases.subject: Environmental Justice Australia
cases.subject_binding: exact legal/entity binding retained in Phase 5 C4 evidence review
cases.attribution_evidence: P&L prints grants as a distinct row
cases.incompatibilities: a grants row is funding-source evidence, not fundraising income or method revenue

cases.source: Environmental Justice Australia RC4 financial projection retained evidence
cases.subject: Environmental Justice Australia
cases.subject_binding: retained RC4 evidence; exact entity binding documented
cases.amount_status: publishable only under exact mixed label
cases.attribution_evidence: printed row is mixed and source-native
cases.incompatibilities: MUST NOT split into donations, fundraising method, lecture, campaign, appeal, or provider amounts

cases.source: Environmental Justice Australia functional allocation retained evidence
cases.subject: Environmental Justice Australia
cases.subject_binding: retained RC4 evidence; exact entity binding documented
cases.amount: 10% (approximately AUD 585,000 only as rounded percentage × reported total expenses)
cases.attribution_evidence: functional allocation chart labels fundraising and denominator
cases.incompatibilities: MUST NOT allocate the portfolio figure to face-to-face, digital, mail, campaigns, appeals, or providers

cases.subject: Northern Youth Legal Centre (fictional)
cases.incompatibilities: labels do not identify fundraising method/campaign and demonstrate why heuristic totals must not be split
